interpretation_rules.phase_markers: context only, not required to be expressed in proliferative donors
interpretation_rules.aggregate_signal: cannot distinguish intrinsic expression, ambient RNA, doublets, minority cells or incorrect labels
interpretation_rules.source_marker_methods: Inherited author DotPlot verification is not repeated here; standard biological rationale is not falsely attributed as a specific list in the cached paper

CPM.denominator: all rows in that population's mapped retained stable-gene matrix, not only the panel and not cell number
CPM.equal_weight: compute donor CPM first; cohort summary gives each donor weight1/n regardless cell number or total counts
CPM.between_cohorts: scRNA and snRNA differ in capture and compartment; no cross-cohort calibration or purity inference

conditions: identical unique canonical featureIDs and donor IDs

source annotation main stroma partitioned by fixed fibroblast/mural labels
